records.note: The launch of the COMPASS psilocybin Phase 3 study in TRD is a trial start decided by Compass Pathways, an entity in the forecaster's affiliations (investor; the post announces atai raising its stake above 20 percent). Trial starts of an own organization are CONTROL, and the sentence restates company guidance ('is anticipated to launch'). Would map to E-0010 for a third-party forecaster.

Timing of the RL-007 Phase 2b topline (Recognify, an atai alias in the affiliations list); the release of the forecaster's own organization's data. Same treatment as angermayer-0098. No result is claimed. Would map to E-0096 for a third-party forecaster.
'Gems within a goldmine' and 'investors assign zero value' are valuation slogans. No trial, endpoint, price, series or date is named, so no observable event can be written from the words.

records.stage_note: At 2023-08-07 the lead psychedelic program in the passage (MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD, MAPS) was in Phase 3 with no NDA submitted; COMP360 was in Phase 3 and the atai compounds in Phase 1 or 2. Class taken on the lead program's stage.
records.note: The passage names Compass, atai and MAPS data, so the class entry E-0024 (first FDA approval of a psychedelic medicine) is the closest registry event; the FDA, not a sponsor, decides. The strongest phrase in the claim sentence is 'will be approved', bin A; the normative 'should be approved' is weaker and does not govern. No year is named, so the item is undated. Affiliated: he is chairman of atai and an investor in Compass.
Restatement of the 'gems within a goldmine' slogan on a new date and in a new source. Still no trial, endpoint, threshold or date, so still VAGUE. Not DUPLICATE: a different post.
'Far superior' to other ways of administering 5-MeO-DMT is a comparative with no benchmark: no measure, no comparator product and no date. A best-in-class claim, not an observable event.

The first clause reports earlier Phase 1/2a data and is retrospective. 'Potential to revolutionize treatment for difficult-to-treat depression' is a promotional slogan with no endpoint, threshold, series or date, so no criterion can be written. The words do not say the Phase 2b trial meets its primary endpoint.
